title: Capture golden state
summary: Capture a new golden through the governed operation to seal current cause-bearing probes. On macOS it first asks a running Safari to quit and waits for it, never force-quitting, so Safari's state is on disk; Linux and WSL capture does the same for the desktop Chromium, refusing test_machine_sign_in_app_quit_not_proved when it stays open; macOS harness logins, browser identities and Safari's cookie store stay outside the archive. Saving a completed sign-in is this same capture. Capture refuses golden_capture_insufficient_space before writing when the destination filesystem cannot hold the home, and after the new golden is registered it deletes every retired snapshot except that golden and its probes and manifest. An undeclared nonzero probe exit retries once with both attempts retained; a declared failure stops immediately.
